To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the energy levels and wavefunctions of the 2 1S states in He, Li+, B+++, O 6+, Ne8+ and Mg10+ have been calculated to an accuracy of 0.05 cm−1.
the 2S state of He and Li+, and the 2S states of Be++ to Ne8+, are bound states, while the 2S of H− and the 2P state of Li+ are unbound.
the 23S energy levels of He, Li+, and B+++ have been calculated to an accuracy of 10−4 cm−1, and that the Lamb shift of the 23 S state of He is 0·10± 0·05 cm–1, and that of Li+ is 1·07± 0·10 cm-1.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a detailed investigation of the properties of the 23P and 23S states of the hydrogen atom and its isoelectronic ions.
the development of the theory and application of the theory of the quantum mechanics.
the calculation of the energies and the wave functions of the 23 states of the ground configurations 1s22s and 1s22p of He and of the He-like ions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Lamb shift in the 23P states of the H atom and the 23S and 2P states of He and Li+ are now accounted for in terms of quantum electrodynamics to a degree of accuracy comparable to that of other fundamental tests.
the Lamb shift is now firmly established as a fact.
the present theory, with its many approximations, is in good agreement with experiment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the theoretical energies of the 23P states of the H atom and the He atom, the 23P and 23S states of Li+, the 23S and 23P states for Be++, and the 23S, 23P and possibly the 23D states of the H− atom are now accurately predicted.
, with the exception of the Lamb shift in the 23P state of Li+, all the Lamb shifts have now been accounted for.
the Lamb shift in the 23 state of He and Li+ has been observed and that it agrees with the theoretical value within experimental error.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the twenty-parameter wave functions provide a good approximation for the 23 S state of He and the 23 S states of He-like ions.
the 1s2s 23S states of He, He-like ions, and H− are very close to the 1s22s2S state of H, and that they are not significantly affected by electron-electron correlation.
the Lamb shift is the same for the ground state and the first excited state, and this is consistent with the fact that the Lamb shift in hydrogen-like ions is the same for all states.
